title: Product demo
summary: The real product, seen: three screenshots in one window under one camera (drift, punch, snap-scroll, whip), a caption each, in 22 s.

params.name: what
params.description: what the brand is, in plain words; empty reads IDENTITY.md

params.name: action
params.description: the one action at the end

params.name: background
params.description: a background id from the registry; empty uses the brand's first

params.name: shot1Image
params.description: screenshot 1 (path); empty draws a placeholder UI

params.name: shot1Caption
params.default: The overview: everything in one place.

params.name: shot2Caption
params.default: One click to the detail that matters.

params.name: shot3Caption
params.default: Numbers you can act on, as they change.

usage:
npx paper-motion add product-demo --name my-piece
# put the screenshots in, edit CONFIG in pieces/my-piece/scene.html, then:
npx paper-motion render pieces/my-piece/scene.html --motion-blur 5
notes: Wired to the brand folder: needs brand/tokens.json (a palette and a font pair work: pamo add sage-night instrument) and, for the background, a shader-set entry (pamo add mesh-sage).
Made for real screenshots: without them each shot draws a placeholder UI in the brand's colors, so the structure can be judged first.
Uses these moves from the engine: mask-reveal, drift, punch, snap-scroll, whip-pan, flash, word-rise, blur-in.

values.what: Brand videos, made by your coding agent.
values.shot1Caption: The library: every resource has a name.
values.shot2Caption: A board: your agent proposes, you choose.
values.shot3Caption: The kit: every choice adds up.

when: you have real UI to show
a feature tour, a changelog video, an app store preview

beats.name: What
beats.what: the name and what it is

beats.name: Shots
beats.what: three screenshots in one window: drift, punch, snap-scroll, whip
